name: text-directional-blur-slide
title: Directional Blur Slide
description: Chữ lướt vào từ trái 200 px, chỉ nhoè theo chiều ngang như vệt chuyển động của máy quay, nét lại khi dừng.

moworks.author: moworks

options.blur: horizontal blur at the start, stdDeviation px (60)
options.ease: (expo.out): the blur follows the move, 0 when it stops
options.exitAt: s after the start to slide out the other way (null)

credit.author: Moworks Studio
credit.madeNote: the studio's own motion, written here

moworks.notes: x −200 → 0 px in 0.5 s expo.out (cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)); horizontal-only blur (SVG feGaussianBlur stdDeviation "20 0" → "0 0", ≈40 px spread) on the same spline as the move, so it is 0 exactly when the text stops. CSS fallback: scaleX 1.6 → 1.05 → 1 (origin right) with blur 4 px → 0 and opacity 0 → 1 by 60 %. Canvas demo: −220 px over 0.55 s as a 12-sample trail covering 1/48 s (180° shutter at 24 fps), exit +220 px 2.0–2.4 s expo.in; loop 2.6 s. Params: x: quãng lướt (−200 px) · blur: nhoè ngang (40 px) · duration (0.5 s, expo.out) · shutter (180°).
moworks.titleVi: Chữ lướt vào với nhoè ngang
